title: stachys chamissonis var. cooleyae
intro: Stachys chamissonis var. cooleyae, commonly known as Cooley's betony, is a subspecies of the Stachys chamissonis plant, which is a member of the mint family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Cooley's betony include its sedative and anti-anxiety effects, making it a potential remedy for insomnia and other sleep disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties and contribute to its potential health benefits.
